name: isSFiniteKernel_withDensity_of_isFiniteKernel
statement: Kernel α β) [IsFiniteKernel κ] (hf_ne_top : ∀ a b, f a b ≠ ∞) : IsSFiniteKernel (withDensity κ f)

have_tree.name: h_le
have_tree.type: ∀ a b n, ⌈(f a b).toReal⌉₊ ≤ n → f a b ≤ n

have_tree.name: h_zero
have_tree.type: ∀ a b n, ⌈(f a b).toReal⌉₊ ≤ n → fs n a b = 0

children.name: h_sum_a
children.type: ∀ a, Summable fun n => fs n a

children.name: h_finset_sum
children.type: ∀ n, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, fs i a b = min (f a b) n

have_tree.name: h_eq_sum
have_tree.type: withDensity κ f = Kernel.sum fun i => withDensity (seq κ i) f
